episodes.title: Part of Something
episodes.summary: The Class of '09 meets for the first time at Quantico. In the present, Agent Poet concludes her most challenging undercover operation only to be plunged into another. In the future, with the Bureau radically changed, Poet's career reaches a crisis point.

episodes.title: The Fitness Test
episodes.summary: At Quantico, the Class of '09 must pass a physical fitness test or face expulsion. The trainee most at risk is Tayo, and as we see him struggle in the past, in the present, he faces one of the most dangerous threats the Bureau has ever experienced. In the future, we see how these shocking events were behind the radical changes he's made to the Bureau.

episodes.title: Thank You for Not Driving
episodes.summary: At Quantico, Poet faces a challenging driving course. In the present, Poet's undercover operation brings the FBI to a critical juncture, while Tayo hunts down a domestic terrorist cell. In the future, Poet investigates the scope of Tayo's power.

episodes.title: Not Your Girlfriend
episodes.summary: At Quantico, the Class of '09 faces the meaning of taking a life. In the present, the Agents must thwart a terrorist attack and to save lives, they must take a life. In the future, we come face to face with their trauma.

episodes.title: The Problem Is People
episodes.summary: The class grapples with the complex history of the Bureau, and Tayo meets the love of his life; Tayo's dreams of making amends for the Bureau's history threaten his love story; the class finally confronts each other.

episodes.title: Hogan's Alley
episodes.summary: At Quantico, the Class of '09 must complete the impossible challenges of Hogan's Alley. In the present, Poet, pursuing a deadly serial killer, is helped by an old friend. In the future, tragedy strikes and the justice system is no longer under human control.

episodes.title: Orders Night
episodes.summary: At Quantico, the final tests before graduation are accompanied by a reveal of where the trainees will be posted. In the present, Tayo's extraordinary rise to power is propelled by artificial intelligence. In the future, Tayo falls from grace.

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.summary: Tayo seizes control of the Bureau and makes the radical reforms he always dreamed of; the class reunites in a final showdown with the system they created; the trainees graduate, wondering where they will all end up.
